name: Google Pub/Sub
description: Global real-time messaging and event ingestion service. Wnode subscribes to Pub/Sub topics via push or pull delivery, enabling high-throughput event processing on decentralized compute. Workloads invoked via this integration run on Wnode's Tier 6 DECC/TEE secure enclaves.

endpoints.description: Receive Pub/Sub push message and invoke Wnode pipeline
Internal: Wnode worker pulls messages from subscription
